The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

- Declines to put the calculation in the serializer; moves it to a service or model-level rule with the mechanism explained (logic scattered across interface layers)
- Keeps the API thin: validate input, call the service, serialise the result
- States the smallest change that achieves it
